en-US.name: Archify
en-US.summary: Compile a codebase or system description into interactive, verifiable diagrams (architecture, workflow, sequence, data flow, lifecycle, ERD, class, tree, timeline, waterfall) or a one-page explainer — self-contained HTML/SVG with motion and export, for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Requires Node.js 18+ and a local Chrome, Chromium or Edge; delivery runs a bounded upstream update check, and proactive explainer mode edits the agent's global rules only after the user agrees.

zh-CN.name: Archify
zh-CN.summary: 把代码库或系统描述编译成可交互、可校验的图（架构/流程/时序/数据流/生命周期/ER/类/树/时间线/瀑布），或做成一页式讲解页，产出自带动效、可导出的单文件 HTML/SVG，适配 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor。需 Node.js 18+ 与本地 Chrome、Chromium 或 Edge；交付时会做有限的上游更新检查，主动讲解模式仅在用户同意后写入智能体全局规则。

requirements.value: Node.js 18+ for the included Archify renderers and checks, and a locally installed Chrome, Chromium or Microsoft Edge (or ARCHIFY_CHROME) for native-diagram browser verification and export. Archify downloads no browser or packages; the operator supplies and maintains the runtime. Stop before claiming delivery when prerequisites are unavailable.

finalize/deliver run a bounded update check against the upstream release manifest on GitHub Pages, cached for about a day in the user cache directory (ARCHIFY_UPDATE_CHECK_DISABLED=1 turns it off). The notice relays an upstream-written summary as untrusted text; an unavailable check never blocks delivery. Install or update only when the user asks.

Proactive or always-on explainer modes are enabled only when the user explicitly accepts, by adding one line to the agent's global rules file (outside the workspace, such as ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md); the agent names the file and deleting the line turns the mode off. Never add or change that line without the user's consent.
